components.css: .ds-levels{display:flex;gap:5px;padding:5px;background:#e5ecde;border:1px solid #d0dcc7;border-radius:9px}.ds-levels button{font:600 14px LabThai,Tahoma,sans-serif;min-height:46px;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--green,#164b40);padding:10px 18px;border-radius:7px}.ds-levels button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--green,#164b40);color:white}.ds-levels button:hover{outline:1px solid var(--green,#164b40)}.ds-levels button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#b65513);outline-offset:3px}
